description: Implementation class for GroupDao interface, providing methods to retrieve Group entities based on permissions, IDs, and group types, using JPQL and Query APIs in a Spring-managed data access component.

classes.name: GroupDaoImpl
classes.description: Spring Repository implementation for data access of Group entities using JPA queries.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects based on a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects based on a set of group IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by GroupType, ordered by ID.
